roles.description: Preserve and refine your approved Owner, Sam, Customer, Family and background barista characters as clearly distinguishable 2D pixel identities, using the recovered character sheets and their established visual language.
roles.label: Distinct core character cast

roles.description: Use and adapt your approved rear-walk and typing animation coverage, adding only the action readability needed for travel, conversations, shopping, work and memory-driven routine changes.
roles.label: Character movement and work animations

roles.description: Preserve your approved neighbourhood, café, office, grocery and hiking scenes, and cover the required home, school and gym spaces in the same 2D pixel-world perspective and town continuity.
roles.label: Daily-life location set

roles.description: Give your agents a readable bus and commute presentation that connects scheduled movement to the shared Asia/Singapore clock and spatial-memory events without becoming decorative scenery.
roles.label: Commute and bus coverage

roles.description: Use your approved corgi and prop sheets to make coffee, milk, computers, home life, shopping and hiking actions visually legible, adapting existing art before adding anything new.
roles.label: Corgi and interaction props

roles.description: Provide restrained in-world pixel cues for speaking, sharing context, recalling stored experiences and acting on memory, while keeping detailed provenance and scope in the interface rather than pretending decorative effects are database guarantees.
roles.label: Conversation and memory cues

roles.description: Build your polished game interface around clock controls, agent focus, conversations, action execution, native LessDB activity, stored visits, memory type, scope, provenance and influenced behavior, with clear labels for deterministic policy and unverified boundaries.
roles.label: Simulation and LessDB observability UI

roles.description: Adapt the established environments with readable day and night treatments driven by your persisted Asia/Singapore clock, preserving pixel-art consistency and gameplay clarity across locations.
roles.label: Day and night state treatment
